title: Bhavanisagar Branch Canal Embankment Seepage
description: Heavy water leakage breaching the canal wall, flooding neighboring sugarcane fields while starving tail-end farmers.
resolutionNotes: Excavation team dispatched with sandbags. Concrete patch work scheduled for tomorrow morning.

title: Agricultural Borewell Dried Up completely
description: Water table dropped below 600 ft. Standing tomato crop drying up; requesting emergency water tanker support.
resolutionNotes: Inspection verified ground table drop. Emergency tanker supply initiated under drought relief scheme.

title: High Turbidity and Salinity in Irrigation Channel
description: Industrial discharge observed entering Veeranam feeder channel. Salt crusting seen on seedling nursery beds.

title: Dam Distributary Sluice Gate 4 Jammed
description: Gear mechanism stuck due to debris buildup after weekend rains. Water overflowing into bypass drain.
resolutionNotes: Debris cleared by mechanical winch. Winch motor replaced and calibrated; regular flow restored.

title: Illegal Commercial Borewell Extraction near Riverbed
description: Unregistered deep submersible pumps drawing water 24/7 for commercial packaging units without clearance.
